plugins.name: mysocial-intelligence
plugins.description: Social media intelligence for your content and the wider social world. Bundles the Mysocial MCP server with the make-next-post, research-creator-universe and brand-docs skills.

plugins.name: mysocial-intelligence
plugins.description: Social media intelligence for your content and the wider social world.

skills.name: brand-docs
skills.description: Read, update, and create the creator's living Brand Studio documents (audience research, hooks, voice, strategy notes). Use when you learn something durable about the brand worth recording, when asked to update brand documentation, or when you need deep brand context for creative work.

skills.name: brand-products
skills.description: Read and maintain the creator's product catalog in Brand Studio - every offer they sell, its price, its real lifecycle status, and how the offers ladder into each other. Use when advising on pricing, offers, launches, or what to promote, when asked what the creator sells or where their revenue gaps are, and when a new or changed offer comes up that is worth recording.

skills.name: make-next-post
skills.description: Create the strongest evidence-backed next social post using Mysocial creator memory. Use when deciding what to post, developing a topic or draft, or writing and optimizing hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, formats, and production direction for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube.

skills.name: outreach
skills.description: Draft evidence-backed outreach to a saved lead - a brand to pitch or a creator to collaborate with - from what Mysocial has stored about them. Use when a user asks to draft outreach, write a pitch or DM to a lead, prepare the day's outreach batch, or contact someone from their lead list.

skills.name: research-creator-universe
skills.description: Investigate public Creator Universe posts and creators in the context of the connected creator's own topics. Use when a user asks what is working for them, what is hot in their market, what they have not covered, or requests evidence-based research beyond their own channel.
